basic_details.job_title: BBMB Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 9 Trade Apprentice Lineman, Trade Apprentice Electrician Posts
basic_details.short_information: Bhakra Beas Management Board (BBMB) Trade Apprentice Notification 2026 has been released on 15 October 2026 on the official website, bbmb.nic.in. A total of 9 vacancies have been announced through the BBMB Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026 for Lineman and Electrician trades under Notification No. 50142144.

qualification.details: Candidates must have passed the 10th class examination with a minimum of 40% marks from a recognized Board. Applicants must also possess a National Trade Certificate in the notified trade issued by the National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT) or State Council for Vocational Training (SCVT) in the respective trade. Furthermore, candidates must have completed the relevant ITI course.

salary_details.details: The official notification does not mention the stipend amount or exact training duration, other than noting that the apprentices are engaged for the year 2026-27 under the respective ITI trades.

selection_process: Selection of candidates will be made on the basis of merit. If suitable candidates according to the given quota are not available
selection will be carried out on the basis of merit from other available candidates.
how_to_apply: Ensure you possess a valid Aadhaar Card (compulsory for online registration).
Visit the official apprenticeship portal at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in.
Complete the online registration using your personal and educational details.
Upload all necessary documents, including your 10th class marksheet and ITI trade certificate.
Submit your application online between 15 October 2026 (13:00 hours) and 14 November 2026 (17:00 hours).
important_instructions: Power supply continuous operation requires technical considerations; if suitable quota candidates are unavailable, merit selection applies. Having a valid Aadhaar Card is compulsory for online registration on the apprenticeship portal. Applications must be submitted strictly via the online apprenticeship portal within the stipulated window. The notification was issued by the Executive Engineer, Operation & Maintenance Divn, BBMB, Delhi - 110035.

rows.details: Candidates who have passed 10th class and ITI in relevant trade

content_sections.heading: Seats by Trade
content_sections.text: The office of Operation & Maintenance Division, BBMB, Delhi-110035 has invited applications for a total of 9 Trade Apprentice vacancies under the Operation & Maintenance Division for the year 2026-27. Below is the trade-wise break-up of approved vacancies:

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must have passed the 10th class examination with a minimum of 40% marks from a recognized Board. Applicants must also possess a National Trade Certificate in the notified trade issued by the National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT) or State Council for Vocational Training (SCVT) in the respective trade. Furthermore, candidates must have completed the relevant ITI course. Not stated in the notification. Candidates who do not possess the required ITI trade certificate or 10th class qualification with the minimum specified marks are ineligible. If suitable candidates as per the quota are not available, selection will proceed based on merit from other available candidates.

content_sections.heading: Stipend and Training Period
content_sections.text: The official notification does not mention the stipend amount or exact training duration, other than noting that the apprentices are engaged for the year 2026-27 under the respective ITI trades.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BBMB Trade Apprentice
content_sections.text: Ensure you possess a valid Aadhaar Card (compulsory for online registration). Visit the official apprenticeship portal at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in. Complete the online registration using your personal and educational details. Upload all necessary documents, including your 10th class marksheet and ITI trade certificate. Submit your application online between 15 October 2026 (13:00 hours) and 14 November 2026 (17:00 hours).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection of candidates will be made on the basis of merit. If suitable candidates according to the given quota are not available, selection will be carried out on the basis of merit from other available candidates.

content_sections.heading: BBMB Trade Apprentice Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Power supply continuous operation requires technical considerations; if suitable quota candidates are unavailable, merit selection applies. Having a valid Aadhaar Card is compulsory for online registration on the apprenticeship portal. Applications must be submitted strictly via the online apprenticeship portal within the stipulated window. The notification was issued by the Executive Engineer, Operation & Maintenance Divn, BBMB, Delhi - 110035.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced in the BBMB Trade Apprentice notification?
faq.answer: A total of 9 vacancies have been announced for Trade Apprentice Lineman and Trade Electrician posts under Notification No. 50142144.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for BBMB Trade Apprentice recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications on the apprenticeship portal is 14 November 2026 up to 17:00 hours.

faq.question: Q3. What educational qualification is required for BBMB Trade Apprentice?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 10th class examination with a minimum of 40% marks from a recognized Board and possess a National Trade Certificate in the relevant ITI trade from NCVT or SCVT.

faq.question: Q4. Is an Aadhaar Card mandatory to apply?
faq.answer: Yes, possessing a valid Aadhaar Card is compulsory as it is required for online registration on the apprenticeship portal.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for BBMB Trade Apprentice?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for BBMB Trade Apprentice?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official apprenticeship portal at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in between 15 October 2026 and 14 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection procedure for these apprenticeship posts?
faq.answer: Selection is made on the basis of merit. If suitable candidates under the specified quota are not available, selection is done based on merit from other available candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Which trades are covered under this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment covers Trade Apprentice Lineman (for ITI Trades) with 7 vacancies and Trade Apprentice Electrician with 2 vacancies.

faq.question: Q9. What is the age limit for BBMB Trade Apprentice?
faq.answer: The age limit is not stated in the notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website to view BBMB notices?
faq.answer: The official website for BBMB is bbmb.nic.in.
